scripts.title: Vasia2 Lab
scripts.features:
🎯 Core Functions
1. Auto Farming System
Automatic Game Joining - Script automatically finds lobbies and joins games
Automatic Round Completion - Locates map exits and uses them to finish rounds
Automatic Suspect Accusation - Identifies and accuses the correct guilty suspect

Multiple Operation Modes:
Legit (Slow) - Uses pathfinding for realistic movement
Blantant (Fast) - Teleports to targets for maximum speed

2. Speed Hack System
Custom Walk Speed from 16 to 90 (default speed is 16)
Smooth Speed Transitions with adjustable smoothing
Automatic Application when character respawns
Safe Disabling - Restores default speed when turned off

⚙️ Control Elements
AutoFarm Tab:
✅ Auto Farm - Toggle automatic farming on/off
⏸️ Pause Autofarm - Temporarily pause farming
🎯 Farm Mode - Select operation mode (Legal/Fast)
🗺️ Select Map - Choose map to play on

SpeedHack Tab:
🏃 Enable Speed Hack - Toggle speed hack on/off
📊 Speed Value - Adjust speed value (16-90)

Statistics Tab:
💰 Coins display

📊 Information Panel
Game Status:
🟢 Working - AutoFarm operation status
⏱️ Timer - Script running time
🕵️ Guilty - Current guilty suspect
🏠 Queue - Queue status (In Lobby/In Game)
📊 Progress - AutoFarm

Performance & Safety:
🖥️ Performance - FPS and performance metrics
⚠️ Ban Risk - Ban risk assessment (Low/Medium/High)

🛡️ Technical Features
Safety Systems:
Automatic Risk Assessment based on settings
"Legit" Mode for minimum risk
ReplicatedStorage Verification before executing actions

Stability:
Error Handling in all critical functions
Automatic Recovery from crashes
Anti-Spam Protection (debounce system)

Optimization:
Efficient UI Updates without lag
Value Caching to reduce load
Adaptive Delays between actions

🎮 Game Integration
Game Element Detection:
Current map and exit identification
Lobby and game session recognition

Smart Movement:
Pathfinding for obstacle navigation
Teleportation for fast movement
Target arrival detection
Multiple interaction type handling

🔧 Additional Features
Notification System for operation status
Detailed Logging for debugging
Real-time Information Updates
Anti-Duplicate Action Protection
